components.name: Default Button
components.description: Standard bordered bench control for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a2a); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f5f5f5); padding: 8px 14px; min-height: 36px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-default:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--hairline, #3a3a3a); background: var(--surface-2, #1a1a1a); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f5f5f5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-default:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.description: Primary commit — send message, save, create/join confirm.

components.description: Tracked uppercase caption paired with mono readout values in topbar cells.
components.css: .ds-readout-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 16px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a2a); } .ds-label-track { display: block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #8a8a8a); line-height: 1.2; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-cell-value { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--text, #f5f5f5); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; line-height: 1.15; }

narrative.overview:
The connected shell treats a mesh session like an oscilloscope readout: room identity, virtual IP, and path quality are the primary instruments; peers are numbered channels on a graticule; chat is a secondary readout panel. Layout is a horizontal bench — readout band on top, quiet network rail left, channel graticule center, chat readout right — not a three-pane messenger reskin.

Matte black-and-white panels, 1px hairlines, and tracked uppercase labels over mono values carry the instrument metaphor. Path quality (Direct/p2p vs relay/WebSocket) is the chromatic trigger: green only for live direct paths, red only for relay, fault, unread, and error states. No ambient wash, grain, or decorative color elsewhere.

The intro/connect screen (space.css, ConnectView) is a separate visual world and out of scope for this system.
keyCharacteristics: Readout-band chrome: room, VIP, path LEDs + segment bar, peer counts, theme toggle, bezel actions
Two-chroma signal grammar: --live green and --fault red only; everything else neutral B&W
Graticule peer table (.scope-face) with 48×28px grid lines
2px corner radius, hairline borders, tonal layering — no default drop shadows on surfaces
Dark default + light theme via data-theme="light" token swap

rules.name: The Two-Chroma Rule
rules.body: --live and --fault are the only hue accents in the connected shell. Do not introduce blues, yellows, or brand tints on connected surfaces. Neutral gray carries everything else, including caution and offline states.

rules.name: The Path-First Rule
rules.body: Color draws the eye to path quality before chat, settings, or decorative chrome. Green means direct; red means relay, degraded, unread, or error.

rules.name: The Label-Over-Value Rule
rules.body: Instrument captions sit above values: tracked uppercase label, then heavier mono or semibold value. Do not inline label:value pairs in the readout band.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure uses 1px solid var(--border). Hover promotes to var(--hairline). No thick frames, inset glows, or offset drop shadows on bench surfaces.

dos: Do scope all connected tokens and rules under html[data-app="connected"] and connected.css.
Do lead with path quality in topbar and peer list before chat or settings affordances.
Do pair .label-track captions with mono or semibold values in readout surfaces.
Do use --live for p2p/direct and --fault for relay, ws, unread, errors only.
Do keep the graticule grid confined to .scope-face peer channels.
Do use 2px radius and 1px hairlines consistently across buttons, cards, inputs, and bezels.
donts: Don't apply connected-shell tokens to the intro/connect screen (space.css world).
Don't add chromatic accents beyond --live and --fault on connected surfaces.
Don't use drop shadows, grain, or ambient washes on bench panels — overlays only.
Don't reskin as a messenger three-pane layout; chat is a secondary readout, not the home surface.
Don't use Bungee or connect-screen display fonts inside the connected shell.
